sloka: तस्य लाङ्गलहस्तस्य कर्षत: क्षेत्रमण्डलम् ।अहं किलोत्थिता भित्त्वा जगतीं नृपते: सुता ॥ २.११८.२८॥
transliteration: tasya lāṅgalahastasya karṣata: kṣetramaṇḍalam ।ahaṁ kilotthitā bhittvā jagatīṁ nṛpate: sutā ॥ 2.118.28॥

translations.english: When he was ploughing the circular plot of land for performing a sacrifice, it is said I emerged from the earth by breaking it and therefore I became his dauhghter.
